items.title: Industry plenary talk at NSF FuSe Awardees Workshop
items.body: Duk-Hyun Choe gave an industry plenary presentation titled "Hafnia-Based Ferroelectric Memories for DRAM and NAND" at the [NSF FuSe Awardees Workshop](https://blog.umd.edu/fuse/program/) held in University of Maryland, MD, USA.

items.title: Invited talk at DRC 2026
items.body: - Duk-Hyun Choe gave an invited talk titled "Designing Oxide-Channel Ferroelectric Transistors for DRAM and NAND" at the [Device Research Conference (DRC)](https://deviceresearchconference.org/2026/program/keynote-and-invited-speakers) held in University of Michigan, MI, USA.

items.title: New Position: Visiting Researcher at MIT
items.body: - Duk-Hyun will be visiting [Pablo Jarillo-Herrero's group](https://jarillo-herrero.mit.edu/) at MIT on an industrial sabbatical from Samsung.

items.title: Samsung-MIT Semiconductor Workshop at MIT

items.title: Invited Talk at 제 21회 고등과학원 전자구조계산회 (Seoul, Korea)
items.body:
- Duk-Hyun Choe delivered an invited talk titled "Ferroelectric HfO2: from physics to industry" at [제 21회 고등과학원 전자구조계산회](https://events.kias.re.kr/h/ESCW2024/).
- The symposium took place at KIAS ([고등과학원](kias.re.kr)) Seoul, Korea.
- Our NCFET team of 16 members, led by Duk-Hyun Choe, was honored as one of the top 25 teams (ranking undisclosed) at the SAIT Project Festival [~ 67M KRW/team].

- Sanghyun Jo, Duk-Hyun Choe (20% contribution), Hyangsook Lee has been awarded Gold Award in the Samsung Best Paper Awards.
- This represents the 1st place in the Materials Division [10M KRW].
- Duk-Hyun Choe attended the IMW 2023 ([International Memory Workshop](https://www.ewh.ieee.org/soc/eds/imw/)) held in Monterey, CA, USA.

items.title: Promotion: Principal Researcher (CL4)
items.body: - Duk-Hyun Choe has been granted an early promotion to Principal Researcher (CL4) at Samsung Advanced Institute of Technology (SAIT).

items.title: Invited Talk at the 18th Joint Symposium on Dielectrics (Busan, Korea)
items.body:
- Duk-Hyun Choe delivered an invited talk titled "Fundamentals and applications of hafnia-based ferroelectrics for next generation semiconductor technology" at the 18th Joint Symposium on Dielectrics ([제18차 유전체연합심포지엄](https://sites.google.com/view/dielectrics18/%EC%86%8C%EA%B0%9C?authuser=0)). 
- The symposium took place on January 29-31, 2023, at the Westin Josun Busan, Korea.

- Duk-Hyun Choe gave an invited talk titled "Atomic-level understanding of HfO2-based ferroelectrics and their ultrafast polarization switching" at the [`22 ISAF](https://2022.ieee-isaf.org/) conference held in Tours, France.
- Duk-Hyun Choe was invited as a [Young Ferroelectric Investigator](https://2022.ieee-isaf.org/young-investigator-invited-speakers/), and co-chaired 2 sessions with [Dr. Jan Schultheiss](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=5ude2roAAAAJ&hl=de).

- Our paper "[Unexpectedly low barrier of ferroelectric switching in HfO2 via topological domain walls](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.mattod.2021.07.022)" by Duk-Hyun Choe et al. is recognized as [one of the 3 Highlighted Papers](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1369702121004132/pdfft?md5=10c43101ffd012f80c7b20f8fe9d5fa7&pid=1-s2.0-S1369702121004132-main.pdf) in the Nov. issue of Materials Today journal (2021 Impact Factor: 31.04).
- This represents [one of the top 13 papers](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/materials-today/special-issue/10XQSJV19BC) in total 179 published papers in 2021.

- Our paper "Surface-Functionalized Hafnia with Bespoke Ferroelectric Properties for Memory and Logic Applications" by Duk-Hyun Choe et al. is recognized as one of the [15 highlighted papers](https://lnkd.in/gi_X84YX) out of 220+ accepted papers in IEDM 2021. 
- The paper is briefly introduced in the [IEEE EDS Newsletter](https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Feds.ieee.org%2Fimages%2Ffiles%2Fnewsletters%2FNewsletter_Jan22.pdf%3Ffbclid%3DIwAR2px50q_UzJ8TQPKnAb6Zi2Aignsv1pAM8agiZ5oFWWiUzmYb5w8G74kw0&h=AT3EnZh1NmNv3T8D-AWqG7vcryCAohsbc-Ol94-bwMGkyPOQFGxW7cPbN3apQy87mDUI3XhpXRAi5CiTs6xTjJ6K6T2q-VrpuBlRt06tNy3aI5W5KBtrIidwKPUf69s96vl4&__tn__=-UK-R&c[0]=AT2-goktlqDZqY4huF9V2y4Oy6EWji43j8lG8c8H0HdFjk-n_AKaAMxhe_m5Xe6bCAjV55yzzCb3o_iUbFgNhMoVjDuFtxNiHU9s64b_mCTDMyeIszpYOwk7s5XBVWp9fIpo7d_0yY2cVXB0-eL4i1QzKICZcPy48vO6jH1s0kGrjA) as a Noteworthy Paper and in an [article by Mark LePedus](https://semiengineering.com/manufacturing-bits-oct-26/) published in Semiconductor Engineering.

- Duk-Hyun Choe (50% contribution), Jinseong Heo, Sanghyun Jo has been awarded Grand Award in the Samsung Best Paper Awards.
- This represents the 1st place in the entire Samsung Group [30M KRW].
- Duk-Hyun Choe (60% contribution) has been awarded the DS Patent Award by Samsung Electronics [5M KRW].

- The artwork of our paper "[Unexpectedly low barrier of ferroelectric switching in HfO2 via topological domain walls](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.mattod.2021.07.022)" by Duk-Hyun Choe et al. is selected as [Inner Cover](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1369702121003965/pdfft?md5=3b01cd05083c9ab628b8061836dabcfd&pid=1-s2.0-S1369702121003965-main.pdf) in Materials Today journal (2021 Impact Factor: 31.04).

items.title: New Position: Staff Researcher (CL3)
items.body: - Duk-Hyun Choe joined Samsung Advanced Institute of Technology (SAIT) as a Staff Researcher (CL3).
